entries.procedural_badge: Seeded by Claude from the photographs, not by an anatomist; owner review pending. Method: Claude placed one seed per visible belly on 5 cross-sections of his cryosection photographs (15-85 % of the radius, seeds on L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, confidence low/medium/medium/medium/low/medium/low); each seed was grown inside the photographed muscle colour class between the photographed septum lines (Q166) by a 2-D then 3-D compact marker watershed on the pale septa. Seed-jitter stability (every seed moved 1.5 mm in 4 directions): Dice >= 0.91. Median 62 % of its outline per section lies on a photographed pale septum or non-muscle (chance 21 %); where it touches another muscle 41 %. Volume 90.3 cm3 vs reference 77.9 cm3 (repository architecture volume 28.9 cm3 x 2.70, his upper-arm ratio; Holzbaur 2007's per-muscle table not accessible). Only the part between his radial-head and distal-radius planes is segmented.
